entries.name: acetylene
entries.note: PA1 R7 METADATA CORRECTION (output-neutral: C#C must keep emitting 'acetylene'). Was pin:false + hc_override:true with citation 'P-31.1.4.2.4' -- a P-number that does NOT EXIST anywhere in the Blue Book (grep count 0) -- and a note claiming 'PIN is ethyne', which is false for the UNSUBSTITUTED parent. BB:16515 (P-31.1.2.1 heading BB:16513) verbatim: 'The name acetylene is retained for the compound HC=CH. It is the preferred IUPAC name, but substitution of any kind is not allowed; however, in general nomenclature, substitution is allowed, for example fluoroacetylene [fluoroethyne (PIN)], but not by alkyl groups or any other group that extends the carbon chain, nor by characteristic groups expressed by suffixes.' Corroborated BB:2927 'CH=CH acetylene (PIN)' and BB:4989 (P-15.1.8.2.2) 'Type 2b retained names include parent compounds explicitly or implicitly devoid of suffixes; acetylene (PIN) and allene are examples.' So state (a): retained AND the PIN. ethyne is the PIN base only for the SUBSTITUTED series (BB:4995 'bromoacetylene -> bromoethyne (PIN)'), which the substitutive engine already emits. pin:true is the correct flag; hc_override is then redundant and removed. DO NOT mechanically strip hc_override across this file -- doing so here without the pin:true flip would have shipped 'ethyne' for the bare parent, a wrong name.
